Real install output of each standalone, made in a disposable repository with its own installer:

- cheapgpt/: cheapGPT 1.10.0 (80c47fcd200faa974881ba39990af09b1cb83401), install --profile cheap-100, over a project with its own AGENTS.md text and a .codex/config.toml key.
- cloop/: cLoop 1.2.0 (585f9c7afe66d53f37c92a221562021883ae1066), install --profile town, over a project with its own CLAUDE.md and a .claude/settings.json permission.

The instruction files, state.json, hook configurations and config.toml are verbatim. The engines, flows, cards and hook scripts are one-line stubs: removal goes by their paths, never by their content.
